name: list_triggers
description: List Routines (scheduled triggers) owned by this account. Use this to discover trigger IDs (trig_...) for update_trigger and delete_trigger. Each entry includes the Routine's id, name, cron_expression, run_once_at, enabled state, ended_reason, next_run_at, created_at, and persistent_session_id. ended_reason explains why a disabled Routine is disabled (empty = user-paused).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.
